strategy_roster.name: AI Supertrend Pivot Percentile
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > ema(close,10) and close > ema(close,20) and adx(high,low,close,14) > 20 and rsi(close,14) > 50
strategy_roster.exit_long: close < ema(close,10) or close < ema(close,20) or adx(high,low,close,14) < 20 or rsi(close,14) < 50
strategy_roster.notes: The two Supertrends are approximated by EMA(10) and EMA(20); ADX(14)>20 is retained, and RSI(14)>50 is a Williams %R>-50 proxy. Supertrend/pivot calculations are unavailable; the documented 1% stop and 2% target are retained.

strategy_roster.name: Wajdyss MA Expert
strategy_roster.notes: The documented EMA(10)/EMA(20) close-price crossover and opposite exit are translated directly. The 100-pip target, 50-pip stop, trailing, money management, and daily/Friday close filters cannot be represented as percentage exits.

strategy_roster.name: AutoAdjustingStrategy
strategy_roster.entry_long: ema(close,6) > ema(close,14) and ema(close,14) > ema(close,26) and low <= ema(close,14) and macd(close,12,26) > macd_signal(close,12,26,9)
strategy_roster.exit_long: ema(close,6) < ema(close,14) or ema(close,14) < ema(close,26) or crossbelow(macd(close,12,26),macd_signal(close,12,26,9))
strategy_roster.notes: The documented EMA(6/14/26) stack, middle-EMA tag, and MACD(12,26,9) trend alignment are retained. Higher-timeframe momentum, monthly mapping, swing-pip protection, and re-armed dynamic targets are unavailable in the single-series DSL.

strategy_roster.name: Bedo Osaimi Istr
strategy_roster.notes: The documented close-SMA/open-SMA crossover at length 20 is exact, with the inverse cross as the long exit. Both short reversal handling and the unspecified protection are outside this long-only roster entry.

strategy_roster.name: Engulfing with Trend
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > open and roc(close,1) > 0 and close > ema(close,20)
strategy_roster.notes: A bullish candle with positive one-bar momentum and an EMA(20) trend filter proxies the engulfing/SuperTrend condition. Exact candle engulfing, SuperTrend, ATR(10) offset, boring threshold, and point stop level are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Gold RSI Divergence
strategy_roster.entry_long: low < donchian_low_prev(low,2) and roc(rsi(close,60),1) > 0 and rsi(close,60) < 40
strategy_roster.notes: A new two-bar low with a rising RSI proxy and RSI(60)<40 retains the bullish divergence setup. Two-pivot confirmation and the 11/33 pip stop and target are approximated or omitted because they are not percentage fields.

strategy_roster.name: Doji Arrows
strategy_roster.notes: A close above the previous candle high is the executable next-bar proxy for the doji-range breakout, with the mirror low as exit. Doji body classification, optional trailing, and 30/90 price-step protection are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Limits RSI Momentum Bot
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(14)<30 and negative five-bar ROC are explicit fallbacks for the unspecified buy RSI and Momentum thresholds. Pending limit distance, session window, cancellation, protection distances, and sell side are not representable.

strategy_roster.name: Fractals Minimum Distance
strategy_roster.notes: Prior-bar range extremes stand in for confirmed Bill Williams fractals, while positive 20-bar standard deviation is a weak distance/volatility fallback. The pip threshold, confirmation offset, reversal logic, and absence of source stops are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Universal EA
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(14) is used as a stochastic %K/%D oversold-reversal proxy: an upward cross below 40 enters and recovery above 50 exits. The K, D, slowing periods, oversold/overbought controls, and both-direction handling are not expressible.
